lo.t: Opens 12 AM day before performance, closes 3 PM day before. Winners drawn at 10 AM and 3 PM.
lo.inst: Submit online form. Winners notified by email and have five hours to claim and purchase tickets. Limit 2 tickets per person.

vs.sum: The Booth Theatre offers good sightlines with a well-raked mezzanine and clear views from most seats, though legroom can be tight. The theater's elegant, European-inspired design adds to its charm, while sound quality is consistently praised. Facilities are average, with typical restroom and concession offerings.

acc.note: 6 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. Not completely wheelchair accessible. Infrared devices available.
